answer: Boeing's net loss attributable to Boeing Shareholders was $4,202 million in fiscal year 2021 and $4,935 million in fiscal year 2022. This represents an increase in the net loss of 17.5% (or a change of -17.5% in net income/loss).
rationale: Retrieved Net loss attributable to Boeing Shareholders for FY2021 ($4,202 million) and FY2022 ($4,935 million) from Item 7 / Consolidated Results of Operations and Item 8 / Consolidated Statements of Operations. The increase in net loss is (-4935 - (-4202)) / -4202 = -733 / -4202 = +17.444%, which rounds to 17.5%.
